decisions: D1: letter-suffixed sub-phases (Phase 3a) remain UNSUPPORTED; the silent-undercount hole is closed by loud non-conforming-heading detection instead of by widening the grammar. This declines the task's literal WORK item (1) and re-affirms plan-format.md's existing prohibition.
D2: [DESCOPED] is REJECTED as a phase-heading marker; whole-phase descoping uses [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] with a #### Reasoned Exclusions record covering all remaining items.
D3: non-conformance is inconclusive-and-loud (pass-through with named per-heading warnings), never a hard refusal, except under validate-artifact.sh --strict where it is an error.
